description: This file defines the RouteLoader class responsible for configuring application routes in the SuiteCRM project using the Slim framework. It loads route configurations from specified files based on the project-specific API configuration.

classes.name: Api\Core\Loader\RouteLoader
classes.description: Handles loading and registering route definitions into the Slim app instance.

methods.name: configureRoutes
methods.description: Loads route files into the Slim app based on configured routes from ApiConfig.
